name: Media Link Enhancements
description: Provides various enhancements for media entity links.

suggests.drupal/linkit: WYSIWYG/link-field UI for selecting media to link

project_description:
The Media Link Enhancements module gives site owners much needed control over how media is linked and displayed. The module extends core classes to alter media URL and link generation and expands how media is rendered at its canonical URL.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Alters media links so that they point directly to the source file or remote URL 
 Provides a download="filename" attribute for media links 
 Alters links site-wide, including; menus, link fields and WYSIWYG body fields 
 Appends file type and size to media link text for 508 accessibility compliance 
 Redirects standard media links directly to files and remote URLs 
 Provides a binary response for direct download of files at media URLs 
 Provides a robust admin UI for maintaining module features and their settings 
 Each feature allows bundle and extension filtering 
 Integrates with Linkit 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Core's media module 
 Media setting Standalone media URL must be enabled 
 Back to top
